name: YT Downloader
tagline: A free Windows desktop GUI for yt-dlp, with a web companion that sends settings straight to the app.
summary: An independent study project that wraps the open-source yt-dlp downloader in a simple Windows app. Paste a video, playlist or channel link, choose a max and min quality or audio-only, and download with live progress, per-video skip, cancel-all, and automatic skipping of failed videos. It ships as one self-contained exe (Python, yt-dlp and the deno JavaScript runtime bundled) built for free by GitHub Actions, and a GitHub Pages web app that builds ytdlp-gui:// links to open the desktop app pre-filled.
highlights: Single-file Windows exe, no install or account
Min/max quality, audio-only (mp3, m4a, opus, wav, flac), playlists and channels, subtitles
Skip current video, cancel all, and keep going when a video fails
One-click ffmpeg setup for 1080p+ merging and audio conversion
Web page opens the app with settings filled in via a custom ytdlp-gui:// link
Free to run: built by GitHub Actions, hosted on GitHub Pages, downloads run on your own PC
